summary: The HTML file provides reusable UI support and link generation for the HSPnet web application. It contains methods for rendering icon placeholders, building JavaScript links to launch new windows, and manipulating text for browser compatibility.
purpose: To support UI rendering and link generation on web pages, specifically for launching detailed views and calendar grids in new windows, and standardizing the use of spacer icons and browser-specific formatting.

entities.name: HTML
entities.description: Provides UI helper methods for icon placeholders and link creation.

workflows.name: newWindowDetails Link Creation
steps: Replace URL segment with hash using Hashing.AddURLHash.
Optionally include CurrentPage parameter after the hash.

workflows.name: newWindowCalendarGrid Link Creation
steps: Call newWindowLink() with CalendarGrid or CalendarGridNonGrp parameters.
Include shift schedule parameters for group/individual shifts.
Return a formatted link with hashed URL, icon, and title.
